scripts.dev: npm run generate:sw-manifest && npm run build:css && npx serve www
scripts.build: npm run generate:sw-manifest && npm run build:css
scripts.test:unit: npm run generate:sw-manifest && vitest run engine.test.js backup.test.js db.test.js sw-manifest.test.js
scripts.test:security: vitest run backup.test.js db.test.js && playwright test -g "Backup Restore Security|Backup Restore UX|Vault Lock State"
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.android:sync:win: npm run build && npx cap sync android && node scripts/sync-android-win.mjs
scripts.android:open:win: npm run build && npx cap sync android && node scripts/sync-android-win.mjs --open
